Subject: Q2 expansion forecast & pipeline hygiene — Acme Enterprises upsell

Team / Jen,

Quick note to align on the Acme expansion commit for Q2. Finance needs a firm commit by Monday so we can include it in the March close forecast. Current HubSpot deal (ACME-2026-EXP-47) is at "Proposal" with $450,000 ARR potential — Monica, can you confirm the committed amount you expect to move to "Commit" after the renewal conversation?

Action items I want in this thread:
- Monica: update deal stage + commit confidence in HubSpot by EOD Monday and attach the updated commit_review_template.xlsx.
- Rishi / Finance: if there's any recognition/timing constraints we should be aware of, flag them here so we can adjust the forecast.
- Jen / Acme: confirm the target start date for the additional seats and any outstanding procurement steps.

I've attached a quick pipeline snapshot for reference. Monica, if you prefer a short sync tomorrow instead of an EOD update, say the word and I'll schedule 15m.

Thanks,

-- 
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0142

Attachments: acme_pipeline_snapshot_q2.csv, commit_review_template.xlsx

On Fri, Mar 6, 2026 at 2:05 PM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team / Jen,
> 
> Quick note to align on the Acme expansion commit for Q2...

Thanks Marissa — quick update from my side: I ran the renewal call with Jen yesterday. They're very interested in the additional 150 seats (enterprise tier) but have two asks before they confirm: a) a one-off onboarding discount and b) a security attestation that the environment will be isolated for analytics workloads.

Probable committed ARR if both asks are satisfied: $375,000 (we're marking commit confidence at 70%). I'll update HubSpot today to move the deal to "Commit" with that figure and attach the filled commit_review_template.xlsx.

If Finance needs an earlier or different confidence band, happy to mark as "Best Case" instead — Rishi, how should we report for the March forecast?

– Monica
Customer Success Manager
monica.patel@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 7 Mar 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q2 expansion forecast & pipeline hygiene — Acme Enterprises upsell

Thanks for the detail, Monica. For the March close, Finance prefers conservative recognition. Please do this:
- Update HubSpot to "Commit" with $375,000 but set the forecast category to "Committed (70%)" so we can reflect probability-weighted revenue in the rolling forecast.
- If Acme signs a PO or countersignature before March 20th, we will treat it as firm for the month; otherwise we'll record a weighted entry in the pipeline.

Also: please include the procurement timeline in HubSpot (expected PO date) and attach any procurement emails or the signed scope — that'll speed up our close if Jen sends the doc.

I'll merge the updated CSV into the finance model on Monday and share a snapshot with leadership.

-Rishi
Director, FP&A
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

From: Jen Brooks <jen.brooks@acme-enterprises.com>

Hi all,

Appreciate the clear timeline. We can confirm the onboarding discount and the isolation clause in the SOW — attaching the signed scope (acme_signed-scope-v1.pdf) and a procurement timeline. Our legal has approved the SOW, and Finance Ops will issue a PO target for 2026-03-18.

I'll flag any delays immediately, but plan is: PO by 3/18, onboarding to start 4/1. Please treat the $375k as committed for visibility, and Rishi, we can send the PO copy as soon as it's issued.

Best,
